1.w: Now in those days John the Baptist comes, preaching in the wilderness of Judea

2.w: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of the heavens has drawn near.”

3.w: For this is the one having been spoken of through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “A voice of one crying in the wilderness: ‘Prepare the way of the Lord; make straight His paths.’”

4.w: And John himself had his clothing of camel’s hair and a belt of leather around his waist, and his food was locusts and wild honey.

5.w: At that time they were going out to him—Jerusalem and all Judea and all the region around the Jordan.

6.w: And they were being baptized in the Jordan River by him, confessing their sins.

7.w: But having seen many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to his baptism, he said to them, “Offspring of vipers, who warned you⁺ to flee from the coming wrath?

8.w: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance.

9.w: And do not think to say in yourselves, ‘We have Abraham [as] father.’ For I say to you⁺ that out of these stones God is able to raise up children to Abraham.

10.w: And already the ax is laid to the root of the trees; therefore every tree not producing good fruit is cut down and is thrown into fire.

11.w: I indeed baptize you⁺ in water unto repentance, but the One coming after me is mightier than I, of whom I am not sufficient to carry the sandals. He will baptize you⁺ in the Holy Spirit and fire,

12.w: whose winnowing fork [is] in His hand, and He will thoroughly cleanse His threshing floor and will gather His wheat into the barn; but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

13.w: Then Jesus comes from Galilee to the Jordan to John to be baptized by him.

14.w: But John was preventing Him, saying, “I have need to be baptized by You, and You come to me?”

15.w: But answering, Jesus said to him, “Permit [it] presently; for thus it is fitting to us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he permits Him.

16.w: And having been baptized, Jesus immediately went up from the water; and behold, the heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove and coming upon Him.

17.w: And behold, a voice out of the heavens, saying, “This is My Son, the Beloved, in whom I was well pleased.”
